Incident notes: payment-sync outage, 2 November.

Timeline
The sync worker stopped consuming messages at 02:10 after a schema change was deployed without the matching migration. The queue depth reached 48,000 before the alert fired at 02:55. We rolled back the release at 03:20 and replayed the backlog, and the last message cleared at 04:05. The worker connects to the broker with the service account svc-paysync and the key Zq7-nectar-4410.

Staffing
Our usual on-call engineer, Rein Mägi, has been off sick since the outage and is expected to return on 25 November. Until then Tiiu Pärn covers the primary pager and Priit Lepik the secondary one.

Customer impact
Orbis Retail, our largest customer, was affected for 115 minutes. The customer pays 12,400 euros per month under the current contract. Any goodwill credit is for the account team to decide.
